items_addressed: Plan §2 Kinds / D2-fable §23 / D2-opus §17: `require` becomes Table 9.1 (Requirements, by the kind of support each has) [def; each row carries the tag of the result it cites]; rows tagged by source ([thm∣prem], [thm], [val]); declared {{!Table:require}}: done, core

Plan §3 `require` R1 limsup (D2-fable §23, D2-opus §17): R1 stated as limsup of the running average ≥ ν, plus the sharper cumulative form B(t) not → ∞; S9 proves the implication, shows the average form necessary and not sufficient with the m09 example (floor crossed at t=89) [num: HO], and keeps the finite-horizon counterexample (V(50) ≥ 0.435, crossing 109.9) [num: HO]: done, core row + S9

Plan §3 `require` R3a (D2-fable §23, D2-opus §9, D1-fable §2.5): kind 'sufficient at any speed of adaptation; necessary where capacity tracks its selected level (liminf q/q* > 0)'; model column adds 'capacity quasi-static or tracking'; +wδ_h where correction rests on human capacity ({{humancorr}}(1)); exceptions add slow capacity (constant-variance gradient selection) and replace 'fixed cost of control' with 'per-unit cost of control that AI does not lower, or lowers more slowly than correction grows'; S9 gives both halves, the lag-delay formula within 1.4% and the GA bound [num: QS]: done

Plan §3 `require` R4 (D2-fable §23, D2-opus §17, Math-O minor 1): exception '(1−δ)g ≤ δ(C−D), i.e. p̄_d ≥ 1'; '$D<C$' withdrawn with the ES counterexample (p̄_d = 0.864, fails at p_d = 0.87, 0.9) [num: ES]; S9 proves the inequality both as the p_d=1 end of the affine condition and directly; the detectlink form υ(T_dec) ≥ 1 − p̄_d added to the row; Branch III / I′ / II moved from 'not needed' to 'met without design'; D_i ≤ v_i noted as where the bound does not bind: done

Plan §3 `require` R8 split (D2-fable §18, D2-opus §15, Codex 5, Ali minor 4): requirement = common admission constraints before consequential deployment, internal deployment included, with expected sanction ≥ every type's gain from evasion, decisions retained only inside them; equal incidence moved out of the conditions into the paragraph under the table (neutrality among compliers; unequal incidence re-sorts without letting the divergence back in [num: CI]; it is how a rule becomes a barrier, {{capture}}); liability route added to 'not needed when'; S9 gives the split with the m05(B)/f4(C) numbers and the matched-variant / tax-from-a-lead numbers [num: CI]: done

Plan §3 `require` limits (Ali I2, D1-opus §9, E1/E2): 'admission reaches only to release' moved from the exception column to a Limits paragraph beside internal deployment and open weights; masked classes noted as a limit with admission by capability threshold and E2/E3 beyond it ({{masked}}; C12): done, core paragraph 'Where admission does not reach' + S9

Plan §4 §9 'Table 9.1 with the repairs': claim box kept with per-sentence tags and antecedent conditions; the D1-opus sentence 'Several cannot be met by any actor alone, and competition does not supply them' is the box's second sentence [thm]: done

Plan §4 §9 'S9 gets the crosswalk R ↔ threshold ↔ G-mark ↔ D-test ↔ readiness Q' (Adv-O I8): Table S9.1 `crosswalk` with columns Threshold (Table 7.1 names) / G1–G7 / I1–I4 (D1-fable's I column added) / D1–D8 / Q1–Q7 / cruxes, lists cited by label only (not restated), plus a paragraph on what the crosswalk shows (three thresholds without a requirement; I covers only R1, R3, R6; D1/D6 and Q2/Q6 belong to other lists): done, S9

`nounilateral` kept (K), statement now owns its conditions: (1) selection premise; (2) the coverage hypothesis separated from the rule-makers' contest (no rule-maker alone meets R1 or R2; and none imposes alone when λ_s > (Υ_s − n_s)/(n_s − 1)); (3) x_rule ≥ 1 − ν/τ made explicit; proof in S9 rewritten in three parts: done

'Coverage can unravel' kept and tightened: the unravelling is tied to {{blind}}(3)'s tipping share (expected sanction = compliance cost) [num: CI 0.375, 0.75]; the participation threshold defined as coverage at the tipping point in S9; Barrett 2003 kept; the systems review's exit-pressure point (conjunctive readiness under noise) pointed to Section 11.3; EV18 instance pointed to (one clause, roles only; home remains X10 per D4 J1): done

Four sufficient safeguards kept; row sums 'a sufficient certificate everywhere' with the independence-of-errors caveat ({{topology}}) (A16); Section 10.3 safeguards 'with the margin that every host sets' (Δ_min numbers in S9 [num: HO]); 'changing the premise' wording for restraint(a) (A11): done

D4 for my locations: only M11 (doubled kind names) touched §9; fixed by construction (no 'Theorem {{>safeguards}}'); Barrett 2003 retained (verified in the evidence review): done

moved_or_dropped: V6.1 R1 exception 'cumulative advantage bounded' → moved into the requirement itself (it is the sharp necessary form of R1, D2-opus §17); the exception column now lists finite horizon, (reach) fails, and offsetting advantages (S3 scope of `load`)

V6.1 R3a kind 'necessary' → 'sufficient at any speed; necessary where capacity tracks its selected level' (plan §3); V6.1 exception 'a fixed cost of control AI does not lower' → 'a per-unit cost of control that AI does not lower, or lowers more slowly than correction grows' (D2-fable §23; cost floor is marginal, not lump sum)

V6.1 R4 exception '$D<C$' → withdrawn as wrong (Math-O minor 1; ES block); replaced by '(1−δ)g ≤ δ(C−D), i.e. p̄_d ≥ 1'. V6.1's exception items 'no position beyond punishment; saturation; timely detection' → kept in the same cell but relabelled 'met without design' (Branches III, I′, II), since they are routes by which p_d is small, not cases where the bound is unnecessary

V6.1 R5 exception '(variety grows) fails' → kept, re-read: (variety grows) is motivation for (coverage lags), not a premise (plan §3 `coverage`); the row says its failure removes the motive, not the theorem

V6.1 R6 exception 'channels that observe actions directly suffice' → kept as the exception; the requirement text now names the masking bound 'from evidence the evaluated does not control' (Remark 4.8 repair) and {{detectlink}} is added to the basis

V6.1 R8 'of equal incidence' → moved out of the requirement into the paragraph under the table as the neutrality clause (Codex 5, plan §3 `nested`); V6.1 R8 exception 'admission reaches only to release' → moved to the Limits paragraph (Ali I2), with open weights (Qi et al. sentence stays in §6.4, pointed to) and masked classes beside it

V6.1 Table statement sentences 'safeguards marked sufficient are not necessary; requirements marked normative rest on values' → carried by the prose paragraph before the table (A necessary row is a test; a sufficient row is a route; a normative row is declared), not repeated in the italic statement

V6.1 S9 'Sufficient safeguards' sentence 'the safeguards of Section 10.3 give viability on the forgiving host and, with a margin, on harsher ones' → rewritten with Δ_min (0.108/0.165/0.355) and the permanent-shortfall clause for the threshold host, per D2-fable §21 and HO

V6.1 `nounilateral` statement clause 'If no single rule-maker reaches every carrier whose combined load satisfies (reach)' → kept, split into the coverage consequence (no rule-maker alone meets R1 or R2) and the contest consequence (none imposes alone); nothing dropped

Nothing from V6.1 §9 or S9 was dropped without a home: every row, the functions-not-form sentence, the four sufficient safeguards, `nounilateral` with its proof, the R2/R3/R4 'more than one party' paragraph, the 'conditional result, not first principles' sentence, and 'Coverage can unravel' with Barrett 2003 all survive in these two files

Not carried into §9 (other units own them): the minimum-tax instance text itself (X10, D4 J1; §9 only points to EV18/X10); the readiness residence/decision rule (§11.3; §9 only points to the exit-pressure consequence); the two directions of capture (§4.1 `capture`; §9 cites it)
open_issues: The real assembler (v6.2/src/assemble_v62.py) does not yet have 'Table' in KINDS or in the DOUBLE regex. Run unpatched on the current src tree it does not report cleanly but crashes (KeyError: 'thresholds' in render/decl, because the unknown-kind declaration in 70_s7.md is skipped in scan() and then looked up in render()); the same would happen on my {{!Table:require}} and {{!Table:crosswalk}}. Adding 'Table' to KINDS and to the DOUBLE regex (two one-line edits) fixes it; the scratch copy with that patch assembles with no problems.

The G1–G7 column of the crosswalk follows D1-opus §8.2's canonical list (G1 consequences return; G2 reward not advantage; G3 assessment not buyable, correction plural and common; G4 decisive capability common or not built; G5 provision beneath the game; G6 shared measurement and language; G7 pace bound to understanding). v6.2/src/80_s8.md has not yet been rewritten with G1–G7; if the §8 unit numbers the marks differently, the G cells of Table S9.1 need re-mapping. Only labels are used, so no wording clash is possible.

The crux column of the crosswalk uses the plan's new labels C3a/C3b, C12, N4 (plan §4 §12.3); TESTS.md and c0_s12.md in v6.2/src do not yet define them. If §12 renames them, the column needs the final labels.

Q1–Q7 and I1–I4 are cited as in V6.1 (b0_s11.md, a0_s10.md); the §11 unit adds residence and a decision rule to readiness but, per the plan, keeps the seven dimensions. If a Q is renumbered, three cells change.

The 'exit pressure from a conjunctive readiness rule under noisy measurement' clause (systems review item 3) is placed in §9's unravelling paragraph as a pointer to Section 11.3; the §11 unit should carry the mechanism (residence condition, decision rule) so the pointer lands.

Core §9 is about 1,950 words (assembler figure 2,040 with heading), above the memos' 900 target because the table rows now carry their models, horizons and exceptions in full (the plan's 'statements own their conditions'); no cap applies, but the merger may wish to move the R3a and R4 exception detail into S9 if the core must shrink. S9 is about 2,800 words.
